invariant: a card face means the same thing on every surface it is shown on

faces.name: prose with no slot
faces.construct: a face naming no field

faces.name: a face of nothing
faces.construct: an empty face

faces.name: a face of nothing but space
faces.construct: space and tabs alone, kept as they were written

faces.name: a slot standing alone
faces.construct: a face that is one placeholder

faces.name: a slot in prose
faces.construct: a placeholder with words on both sides of it

faces.name: one field placed twice
faces.construct: a face naming one field in two slots

faces.name: two slots with nothing between them
faces.construct: placeholders that touch

faces.name: a field the card leaves out
faces.construct: a declared field the card holds nothing under

faces.name: a field written empty
faces.construct: a heading with nothing under it

faces.name: a field name with a space in it
faces.construct: a field named in two words

faces.name: a slot name with space around it
faces.construct: the name between the braces is a field's name written exactly, so this one is not Name

faces.name: a slot with no name
faces.construct: empty braces, which are a slot naming a field of no name

faces.name: a slot name across two lines
faces.construct: a line break inside the braces, which is part of the name

faces.name: braces that are not doubled
faces.construct: single braces, which open no slot

faces.name: braces that never close
faces.construct: an opening pair with no closing pair after it

faces.name: braces three deep
faces.construct: a slot inside a brace, where the outermost brace is text

faces.name: a card writing one field twice
faces.construct: two headings of one name in a card, where the first stands

faces.name: emphasis around a slot
faces.construct: a placeholder inside strong emphasis

faces.name: emphasis inside emphasis
faces.construct: nested emphasis, written both ways

faces.name: a value that is itself emphasis
faces.construct: marks written in the card rather than in the face

faces.name: a slot in a code span
faces.construct: the braces are read inside code too, because the format escapes nothing

faces.name: a slot in a fence
faces.construct: a fenced block, whose braces are read like any others

faces.name: a slot in a link
faces.construct: a placeholder standing as the text of a link

faces.name: a slot in a wikilink
faces.construct: a placeholder standing as the target of a wikilink

faces.name: an embed and no slot
faces.construct: an embed, whose brackets are no braces

faces.name: a picture laid out from two fields
faces.construct: placeholders in both halves of an image

faces.name: a slot inside a tag
faces.construct: HTML, which a face holds as readily as marks

faces.name: a slot inside an attribute
faces.construct: a placeholder standing in an attribute's value

faces.name: a slot in a table cell
faces.construct: a table, whose pipes and rules are text around the slot

faces.name: a slot on each line of a list
faces.construct: a list, whose bullets are text around the slots

faces.name: a slot in a quotation
faces.construct: a blockquote

faces.name: a slot under a fourth-level heading
faces.construct: the deepest heading a card may write, the three above it being spent

faces.name: a value carrying braces of its own
faces.construct: what a value stands in the text is not read again

faces.name: a value carrying the marks a replacement is written with
faces.construct: dollars in a value, which are text and not a pattern

faces.name: a value carrying backslashes
faces.construct: an escape in a value, which is the two characters and no escape

faces.name: a value over several lines
faces.construct: a paragraph written into a slot that stands on one line

faces.name: a value of nothing but space
faces.construct: space written under a heading, which is neither empty nor a word

faces.name: a face whose lines end the Windows way
faces.construct: carriage returns, which are the file's own and are carried through

faces.name: a face that is not Latin
faces.construct: field names and values in another script

faces.name: a value beyond the basic plane
faces.construct: characters that are one code point and two UTF-16 units

faces.name: a field named beyond the basic plane
faces.construct: a slot whose name is one code point counted in bytes on one side and in UTF-16 units on the other
